title: The 'association' of 24 retired officials pushing UAP programs back under government oversight

tellings.quote: There has arisen uh an insurgency group that have uh occupied extremely high positions uh in the defense department uh inside the central intelligence agency

plain: A group of about two dozen retired officials is said to be working to bring secret UAP programmes (UAP, or unidentified anomalous phenomena, is the official term for UFOs) back under proper government oversight, including work held inside aerospace companies. Dan Sheehan, a guest on the show, passes this on from a man named Michael Phillip and calls the group an 'insurgency' whose members 'have occupied extremely high positions' in the Defense Department and the CIA. If true, it would mean people from inside the system believe these programmes have slipped out of the government's control.
